raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China exporters of firearms, optics, and related components to the US market, this shifts licensing and classification requirements. Exporters must re-verify ECCN classification, ITAR/USML boundary, and BIS licensing policy for shotguns, rifles, and parts under ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504 families, and confirm whether items fall under State Department (ITAR) or Commerce (EAR) jurisdiction. Section 301 tariffs and HTS alignment remain applicable for US-bound shipments, and Entity List / restricted party screening is mandatory. Note: China-origin firearms and ammunition face separate US import restrictions (e.g., Section 1260D / ATF import bans), so confirm import eligibility before shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国市场出口枪支、光学器件及相关部件的中国出口商而言，许可与分类要求随之调整。出口商须重新核实ECCN分类、ITAR/USML边界，以及霰弹枪、步枪及零部件在ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504项下的BIS许可政策，并确认物项属于国务院（ITAR）还是商务部（EAR）管辖。对美出货仍需关注301关税与HTS归类一致性，且必须进行实体清单/受限方筛查。注意：中国原产枪支弹药还面临美国单独的进口限制（如Section 1260D / ATF进口禁令），出货前须确认进口合法性。

checklist.desc: Re-classify firearms, ammunition, and parts under ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504 and confirm whether items fall under EAR or ITAR/USML jurisdiction after the rule rescission.

checklist.task: BIS license policy & Entity List screening
checklist.desc: Verify current BIS licensing policy for the destination and run restricted party / Entity List screening; retain end-user and end-use statements.
Map the 10-digit HTS line (e.g., 9302, 9303, 9305) against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
Confirm China-origin firearms/ammunition import eligibility under US restrictions (Section 1260D / ATF) and obtain any required import permits before shipment.

checklist.task: FCC / product safety conformity where applicable
checklist.desc: For electronic optics or RF-enabled accessories, confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity and supplier FCC IDs before US entry.
